request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe: an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, including standardized interfaces, documentation, SDKs, JSON-RPC endpoints, agent-facing documentation, protocol skills packaging, and an MCP server.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is described as producing documentation, auto-generated SDKs in multiple languages, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from a verified interface definition for each protocol.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 has already put the Tx3 developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, at 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal claims there is currently no common interface mechanism across Cardano protocols, increasing integration cost and making cross-protocol composability impractical.
The proposal claims AI agents create a need for auditable intent-based interaction with deterministic underlying transactions to avoid irreversible hallucinated on-chain actions.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audit documentation.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal describes treasury administration through Sundae Labs smart contracts, Intersect admin and leadership roles, an external Oversight Committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, audit references, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe Tx3 expansion covering protocol onboarding, developer and agent interfaces, and smart-contract-managed disbursement through Intersect, with several governance and NCL claims tied to external references but several technical and adoption-impact claims asserted without detailed evidence in the anchor text.
